prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

LEFT: ONE real adult Kenyan man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, bold emerald-green eyeliner with a sheer burgundy-stained lip, deep ebony skin with a soft glow, a playful half-grin, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, a gold ship's anchor, a gold barrel-shaped weight, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, an iron pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum hair ornaments.
